in_marathi.name: Ansarth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ansarth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ansarth is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ansa’ meaning 'breath' and ‘ratha’ meaning 'chariot'. This name is believed to signify the divine chariot of God's wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Ansarth is associated with Lord Vishnu, the preserver, who is known for his boundless wisdom.
